row.evidence: Swimlane Turbine supports SCIM 2.0 (create, retrieve, update, deactivate and, from Turbine 26.0.0, delete users; groups), while its enterprise packaging page lists five tiers (Starter, Core, Plus, Premium, Elite) with no published prices.
row.notes: Quote-only: Swimlane's packaging page names five Turbine tiers (Starter, Core, Plus, Premium, Elite, sized by daily automated actions and user count) but publishes no prices and routes every tier to sales, so team and SCIM prices are null and the tier that includes SCIM is not stated. New row. SCIM 2.0 endpoint at /tenant/api/account/{ACCOUNT_ID}/scim/v2 authenticated with an Account Admin's Personal Access Token; documented with Okta (generic SCIM 2.0 App), Entra (non-gallery app), JumpCloud (custom app, group-based only) and Ping. Deprovisioning disables the user (DELETE only on Turbine 26.0.0+). Roles are never set by SCIM; SuperAdmin/Account Admin cannot be provisioned. SAML has no JIT; LDAP/AD directory services sync is the other automated path. Audit Log API (PAT, account admins) is documented.

auth.token_source: Edit Profile > Personal Access Token (PAT of an Account Admin)

operations.notes: DELETE /Users/{id} only on Turbine 26.0.0 and later; earlier versions deactivate via active=false. JumpCloud reactivation re-enables the user.

deprovision.notes: Suspension or removal from all SCIM-managed groups disables the user; explicit SCIM DELETE deletes the user on Turbine 26.0.0+.

pagination.notes: Users and Groups GET accept startIndex and count.

attributes.notes: Field mapping table: userName->Email, name.givenName->firstname, name.familyName->lastname, displayName, groups, active->disabled. middleName, locale and externalId appear in request/response examples.

roles.how: Roles are not set over SCIM; assign roles to synced groups in Turbine

rate_limits.text: Turbine Cloud applies a global rate limit to every HTTP request through the public load balancer (429 when exceeded); no figure published.

limitations.text: SCIM cannot provision SuperAdmin or Account Admin users.
JumpCloud can provision users only through SCIM-provisioned user groups, not individually.
Entra provisioning cycles take about 40 minutes for users.

scim.notes: No Swimlane page states which tier includes SCIM. SCIM can be enabled alongside SAML and LDAP; SAML is not a prerequisite.

audit_log_api.notes: GET /api/public/audit/account/{account_id}/auditlogs with a PAT in the Private-Token header; account admins only.

user_api.notes: Swimlane has a general REST API (PAT or username/password token) but publishes no user, group or role management endpoints apart from SCIM.

okta.notes: No Swimlane OIN app (okta.com/integrations/swimlane/ 404); Swimlane's guide uses Okta's generic SCIM 2.0 App from the catalogue.

entra.notes: No Swimlane entry in Microsoft Learn's SaaS tutorial index; Swimlane documents a non-gallery enterprise app.

jumpcloud.notes: Custom Application with Export users to this app.

fallbacks.other_sync: Microsoft Active Directory / LDAP Directory Services sync (on login and nightly)
